narrative.details:
This is unexpected. It looks like Fenstad might be on to something after all. I found traces of substances used in mind control potions.

It isn't unheard of for perfumes to have some of this, but a few of the ingredients I detected... This is serious alchemy, along the abilities of a member of the Royal Apothecary Society.
narrative.objectives: Return to Fenstad Argyle outside the bank in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So, I was right. We must waste no time. We must determine the source of these tainted fragrances.

Here, to repay you for the purchase of the cologne and perfume.
